specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : FindSingleNumber_precond nums),
    (filterlist (FindSingleNumber nums h_precond) nums).length = 1

specs.name: FindSingleNumber_result_mem
specs.stmt:

    FindSingleNumber nums h_precond ∈ nums

specs.name: FindSingleNumber_others_count_two
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : FindSingleNumber_precond nums),
    ∀ (x : Int), x ∈ nums → x ≠ FindSingleNumber nums h_precond →
    (filterlist x nums).length = 2

specs.name: FindSingleNumber_result_unique
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : FindSingleNumber_precond nums),
    nums.count (FindSingleNumber nums h_precond) = 1

specs.name: FindSingleNumber_filter_singleton
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : FindSingleNumber_precond nums),
    (filterlist (FindSingleNumber nums h_precond) nums).length = 1 ∧
    FindSingleNumber nums h_precond ∈ nums

specs.name: FindSingleNumber_partition
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : FindSingleNumber_precond nums),
    ∀ (x : Int), x ∈ nums →
    (x = FindSingleNumber nums h_precond) ∧ ((filterlist x nums).length = 2)

specs.name: FindSingleNumber_filterlist_eq_singleton
specs.stmt:

    ∃ (v : Int), filterlist (FindSingleNumber nums h_precond) nums = [v]

specs.name: FindSingleNumber_not_duplicated
specs.stmt:

    ¬ ((filterlist (FindSingleNumber nums h_precond) nums).length = 2)

specs.name: FindSingleNumber_count_leq_two
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : FindSingleNumber_precond nums),
    ∀ (x : Int), x ∈ nums →
    (filterlist x nums).length = 1 ∧ (filterlist x nums).length = 2

specs.name: FindSingleNumber_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:

    FindSingleNumber_postcond nums (FindSingleNumber nums h) h
